prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet's Journey", "Select whether you want a quick preset companion or a personalized custom creation.", "Explore Adoption Paths"]
1: ["Preview Your Custom Pet", "Check how your pet looks before completing the official adoption certificate.", "Pet Preview", "Confirm & Adopt"]
2: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is loading! Enjoy the interactive sandbox while background setup completes.", "Playground Sandbox", "Try interacting with your pet while final system setup finishes.", "Interactive Pet Sandbox"]
3: []
4: ["Sign In to Sync Your Companion", "Your existing pet progress will be linked directly to your cloud account.", "Signing in preserves your current pet and enables cross-device sync."]
5: ["Click the pet icon in your system tray anytime to control or hide your desktop companion."]
6: ["Setting Up Desktop Pet", "Rendering custom assets and calibrating desktop placement. Almost ready!"]
7: ["Unlocks Exclusive Starter Crown Item"]
8: ["Setup Complete Chime"]
9: ["Select Your Adoption Style", "Pick Quick Adopt for instant fun or Custom Creation for personalized traits."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or exclusive items
